review_evidence: CayleyMengerVolume.lean: defines cayleyMenger matrix and proves cayleyMenger_det_segment, cayleyMenger_det_triangle, cayleyMenger_det_triangle_centeredGram, cayleyMenger_det_heron with explicit determinant expansions

Schoenberg.lean: proves centeredGram_apply_eq_inner (polarization identity), centeredGram_eq_gram, posSemidef_centeredGram, rank_centeredGram_le, and schoenberg_easy (necessary conditions of Schoenberg's theorem)

SchoenbergHard.lean: constructs rank-controlled PSD factorization (exists_conjTranspose_mul_self_of_rank_le via spectral theorem + scatter matrix) and proves schoenberg_hard (sufficiency) and schoenberg (full iff characterization)
ScottMaps.lean: defines PreservesDirectedSup and proves Scott's Propositions 2.5–2.7 (preservesDirectedSup_monotone, scottOpen_preimage, proposition_2_5, proposition_2_6, proposition_2_7_sup/inf)

Exercise221.lean: formalizes Scott's system C (cones + terminator singletons), defines juxtapose (left-to-right biased concatenation), proves nested-or-disjoint, total elements, and juxtapose_cone/juxtapose_singleton_mem

Recursive.lean: builds choice-free primitive-recursive arithmetic (sqrt, pairing, add/mul/sub/pred/exp/halfParity) and decidability/enumerability layer (RecDecidable, REPred) with closure under and/or/not/comp/bForall/foldCode
Theorem74.lean: proves Theorem 7.4 for product (prodPresentation, proj₀/proj₁/paired/prodMap computable) and sum (sumPresentation, inMap/outMap computable) of effectively given domains
LinearProgramming.lean: defines ExtendedLP/ValidELP structures, dualize, weakDuality (via extended Farkas), strongDuality (case split on extendedFarkas), and optimum OppositesOpt
CommonBasis.lean: defines CompleteFlag, ofBasis, PrefixSet, proves common_apartment (two flags share an ordered basis up to permutation) and common_basis_orderings (explicit prefix-span formulas)
